entities.summary: Gabino Crispín Gaínza Fernández de Medrano was a Spanish military officer, knight of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta and prominent politician in Spain's American colonies. He supported and declared independence on 15 September 1821 in the Kingdom of Guatemala, becoming the first ruler or president "jefe político superior" of a united and independent Central America extending from Soconusco through Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua and Costa Rica; leader of the Consultive Junta of Guatemala until its dissolution on 21 February 1822.

entities.summary: Gabino Crispín Gaínza Fernández de Medrano was a Spanish military officer, knight of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta and prominent politician in Spain's American colonies. He supported and declared independence on 15 September 1821 in the Kingdom of Guatemala, becoming the first ruler or president "jefe político superior" of a united and independent Central America extending from Soconusco through Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua and Costa Rica; leader of the Consultive Junta of Guatemala until its dissolution on 21 February 1822.
